title: HTTP CLI response envelope
description: Top-level shape of every HTTP CLI response body. Exactly one of data or error is present (data may be null on 204-less empty results).

data.description: Result payload: object, array, scalar, or null. Help documents are delivered here.

meta.description: Non-semantic metadata (request_id, pagination). Clients must ignore unknown keys.

code.description: Stable machine-readable identifier. Standard codes: invalid_param, missing_param, bad_body, unauthorized, forbidden, unknown_command, not_found, method_not_allowed, conflict, payload_too_large, unsupported_media_type, rate_limited, internal_error.

hint.description: Actionable next step. Recommended on every client-fixable error. Must not leak secrets or other tenants' data.

details.description: Structured context, e.g. the offending parameter name.
